boards.title: Přehled stanice a rádií
boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one review board containing exactly FOUR separate proposed T-Deck firmware screens, in a neat 2 by 2 grid.
Primary request: high fidelity Czech GUARD-MESH Guardian UI design proposal for the EXISTING 320x240 landscape T-Deck display. Use provided screenshots ONLY as visual style references, not as edit targets. Keep exact existing dark firmware style and plausible small-screen content density. Each screen is a flat rectangular 4:3 screenshot, scaled uniformly to about 720x540 on a landscape board. No physical device, phone, perspective, shadows, desktop browser frame or branding invention.
Style: solid black #000 background, deep almost black navy #0a1620 cards, subtle blue #0087ff 1px borders, corner radius corresponding to 7px at native resolution. Clean white compact sans typography equivalent to Montserrat 12/14 at native resolution; grey supporting text, blue/cyan outline icons. Orange #f29d38 primary buttons with black text/icons. Cyan progress bars. Green=verified good, amber=unverified/pending, grey=unknown/offline, red=failed. Keep the SAME shared top status bar with back chevron, page title, 09:08 time, tiny signal and 77% battery as current reference. No huge headings inside the 320x240 UI, no bottom phone navigation, no gradients or glassmorphism.
Composition: outside each screenshot on the board place a short caption giving SCREEN NUMBER, FEATURE ID and function name; these captions are DESIGN ANNOTATIONS, never part of the device UI. A small board header outside screenshots says "GUARDIAN V3 · NÁVRH K VÝBĚRU". Screens should fill most of board, regular gutters, readable. Each screen should be visually independent. All proposed states/sample station data are illustrative, not live.
Constraints: Preserve all Czech text and diacritics accurately. Use only explicitly described capabilities. No invented RF/LoRa forwarding or delivery success. No giant imaginary controls or excessive tiny text. Only these four screens:
01 | F01/F10 | Hlavní přehled. Page title "Guardian". Evolve current dashboard: left panel RX 64%, cyan bar, "Přijaté 5", "K odeslání 1", "2 nové", compact CAT/VARA/Řízení indicators. Right column four comfortably legible 32px-or-larger native buttons "Zprávy", "Síť", "Stanice", orange "Napsat", with outline icons. Below three 32px icon buttons gear, bell with badge 2, home. The station and bell are OPTIONAL added entries.
02 | F01 | Stanice. Page title "Stanice". Small callsign "OK7PS · JO70". Two separate stacked radio cards: "Rádio 1 · IC-7300", green "Připraveno", "7,110 MHz · USB", "VARA · řízení běží"; second "Rádio 2 · K5", amber "Neověřeno", "145,500 MHz · FM", "SC-FTN · pro přenos". Compact bottom counts "Inbox 5 · Fronta 1", and server row "ARDOS-CZ · Připojeno". The amber second radio is not falsely marked ready.
03 | F02 | Detail rádia. Page title "Rádio 2". Radio selector chips "Rádio 1" and orange-selected "Rádio 2". Compact diagnostic rows "K5 · připojeno", "145,500 MHz · FM", "SC-FTN · Neověřeno", "Modem se spouští pro přenos", "Řízení: běží", "Scanner: vypnut", "Kalibrace: neaktivní". A blue outline "Další údaje" footer button can open more diagnostic rows via scrolling, not execute anything. No universal dBm unit.
04 | F03 | Aktivní přenosy. Page title "Přenosy". Radio selector or clearly labeled two stacked transfers "Rádio 1 · Příjem", "OK1ABC → OK7PS", cyan 64% bar and "12 / 19 KiB · VARA"; "Rádio 2 · Odesílání", "OK7PS → OK2DEF", unknown progress "-" and "SC-FTN". Small bottom explanatory text "Průběh není potvrzení doručení".
